text: Final dependency decisions: KEEP Cats Core internally for genuinely independent ValidatedNec accumulation behind domain-first Scala 3 ADTs; KEEP Cats Effect only in the JVM loader/store adapter for blocking suspension, Resource safety, cancellation, and bounded deterministic concurrency; KEEP AND NARROW BidsStore[F] to recursive deterministic entries plus UTF-8 reads with in-memory and JVM Path interpreters. No algebraic instances were introduced, so law tests are not applicable. REJECT public Cats validation types, effectful shared domain models, unsafeRun, unbounded parallelism, generalized filesystem operations, remote/browser stores, writes, caching, retries, and FS2 without a measured follow-up use case. No unresolved compatibility gap remains in epic scope.
